content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Guest Lecturers are paid an honorarium of Rs. 140 per period, subject to a maximum of Rs. 15,000 per month, as per government rates applicable from time to time. The engagement is for training session 2026-27 on guest lecturer (guest instructor) terms against vacant regular posts. Services are automatically terminated upon the regular or transferred appointment of faculty by the government, or if performance is unsatisfactory.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ITI Kurud Guest Lecturer
content_sections.text: Obtain the prescribed application format from the ITI Kurud website or notice board. Fill out the application form completely with correct details and attach a passport-size photograph. Self-attest copies of all required educational, technical, caste, and residence certificates, along with 10th/11th mark sheets and a valid LMV driving license. Submit the completed application form in person or send it via Indian Post to the office of the Principal, Government Industrial Training Institute Kurud, District Dhamtari (C.G.). Ensure the application reaches the office on or before 30 October 2026 during office hours.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Self-attested copy of 10th marksheet or 11th marksheet Technical qualification certificates and marksheets (NCVT/SCVT/Degree/Diploma) Valid LMV Driving License Caste certificate issued by a competent authority Chhattisgarh domicile certificate Affidavit as per the prescribed format Other relevant supporting documents

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applicants must be native residents of Chhattisgarh with a valid domicile certificate. Applications not received in the prescribed format or received after the last date will be rejected. Candidates applying for multiple trades must submit separate applications for each trade. The applicant must provide a correct mobile number; the institute will communicate via phone calls for interviews or invitations. Selected guest lecturers cannot claim regular appointment based on this service.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are announced in ITI Kurud Guest Lecturer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 2 vacancies have been announced for Mechanic Diesel and Mechanic Electric Vehicle trades.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the offline application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form is 30 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for ITI Kurud Guest Lecturer posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed High School along with an NCVT/SCVT certificate, Degree, Diploma, or B.Voc in the relevant trade or branch, and possess a valid LMV driving license.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary or honorarium provided for ITI Kurud Guest Lecturers?
faq.answer: Selected candidates receive an honorarium of Rs. 140 per period up to a maximum of Rs. 15,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline by hand or via Indian Post to ITI Kurud.

faq.question: Q7. Are candidates required to submit separate forms for multiple trades?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates applying for more than one trade or subject must submit separate applications for each.

faq.question: Q8. Is this job permanent?
faq.answer: No, this is a guest lecturer engagement for the training session 2026-27 against vacant regular posts, and services will automatically terminate upon regular appointment or transfer.
